releaseNotes: DukanBILL Desktop v1.9.22 — Critical Data Recovery & Self-Healing Update: Automatically recovers and migrates all products, sales history, customers, suppliers, purchases, and active licenses from prior MargPOS Desktop installations into DukanBILL. Fixes the empty/missing data issue for users who updated to v1.9.21. Decouples and permanently locks data directory to ensure future rebrand safety.
